title: Seattle: you never see the stars
old_caption: The stars yelled 'we're up here' and a Seattle cloud slid right over them mid-sentence. So they shoved the clouds apart. Pisces, Cancer and Scorpio: very Seattle.

title: Three months in.
old_caption: Three months: a borrowed scarf, a list of baby names, hearts everywhere. Then one text ended it. Pisces has not stopped crying. Which dealbreaker do you say first?

title: We've made people disposable
old_caption: The stars run a lost and found for the swiped, the ghosted and the left on read. The belt runs too fast until Capricorn slams STOP, and every grey star gets its color back. Who deserves a second look today?

title: Astrology for dummies
old_caption: A brand-new star asks what its sign is, why anyone needs its birth time, and why everyone blames Mercury for the wifi. Mercury would like a word. What did you think was too dumb to ask?

title: 8 billion people.
old_caption: 8 billion people, and three separate windows are thinking 'no one gets me' at the exact same time. The gold star taps on the glass to point that out. Who's up looking at the sky with you tonight?

title: The 4 elements in 15 seconds
old_caption: Fifteen seconds, four elements. Fire left before the headline finished, Taurus napped on a flower, air talked about aliens, Pisces cried a whole sea. Which element are you?

title: Flip it
old_caption: Swipe, swipe, swipe: judged in 0.3 seconds. The gold star is personally offended, because those people are made of stardust. Theirs. How long do you actually look before deciding?

title: Seen. 3 days ago.
old_caption: 'Had a really good time tonight.' Seen, three days ago. The stars counted. A tiny ghost floated out of the phone and waved. Capricorn blew the whistle. Who else has met this ghost?

title: Stuck on 'hey'.
old_caption: Day 41 of hey. Good u. Good. The gold star fell asleep, a spider moved into the chat, and the stars officially declared it a screensaver. What's the longest you've been stuck on hey?

title: The 12 houses, explained
old_caption: Your chart is a 12-room building, and the landlord star is giving a very fast tour. Heart eyes in the 5th, a wink in the 7th, a full nap in the 12th. Which room do you spend the most time in?
